plain_english_summary: The UK launch needs VAT review, low-value goods controls, product safety evidence, consumer cancellation wording, and cosmetic responsible-person checks before direct-sale cosmetics.

tax.rule_summary: UK VAT treatment depends on business location, registration status, where goods are located at sale, and consignment value.
tax.operational_gate: Do not publish UK checkout until VAT registration and collection rules are confirmed.

duties_and_imports.rule_summary: For UK cross-border orders, backend records must know consignment value, product type, HS code, and country of origin before duties and import-tax handling is approved.

shipping.customer_promise_rule: Show delivery arrangements, costs, and expected delivery timing before checkout.
shipping.hold_rule: If supplier processing plus shipping time is unknown, the product cannot be published for UK checkout.

consumer_rules.pre_order_information: Product description, total price including taxes where required, payment methods, delivery arrangements, cancellation rights, and seller contact details must be clear before order.
consumer_rules.cancellation_rule: UK online customers generally must be told they can cancel up to 14 days after delivery unless an exception applies.
consumer_rules.delivery_rule: Use a 30-day delivery control unless a different delivery time is agreed with the customer.

product_safety.general_rule: If the business makes, imports, distributes, or sells consumer products in the UK, it must make sure products are safe and correctly labelled.
product_safety.cosmetics_gb: Direct-sale cosmetics for Great Britain require notification, responsible-person details, product information file location, ingredient summary, label image, and packaging photo.
product_safety.cosmetics_ni: Northern Ireland can have a separate cosmetics route. Treat cosmetics for NI as blocked until reviewed.
